meme-commentary.name: Meme commentary (faceless, kinetic captions + full-screen graphics)
meme-commentary.visuals: Something new every 1-2 s (0.8 s in the cold open). Kinetic captions on charcoal (template caption): 1-4 key words cut exactly on the spoken word, sometimes with a face or logo inside the sentence or written over a photo. Stats, photos and receipts fill the whole screen (full-frame graphics, no floating cards). A 0.5-1 s reaction clip after a joke lands (placeholder until you add it). Never the presenter's face
meme-commentary.transitions: Hard cuts on the word. No fades, no stacking
